anchor: v1::Grace Odhiambo, ORD-20768. The leather hiking boots are half a size too small. Can I exchange them?

result.text: Yes, you can exchange them. Your boots were delivered 11 days ago and are unopened, so they're within the 30-day window, and I've started the return (RMA-20768) with the reason "wrong size." To get the half-size-up pair, place a new order for that size. The replacement ships once we scan the returned boots at the warehouse. If the new pair costs more, the difference is charged at checkout; the return carries no fee, and the $159 refund is processed 5–7 business days after the boots arrive.

results.title: Exchanges
results.body: Footwear and apparel can be exchanged for a different size or color within 30 days of delivery at no cost. To exchange, start a return with reason "wrong_size" and place a new order; the replacement ships once the return is scanned.
